sections.title: Examining the School to Prison Pipeline: Implications of History, Policy, and Race
sections.description: The term school-to-prison pipeline typically refers to a disturbing trend in which punitive policies have led to children being funneled out of schools and into the criminal justice system at an alarming rate. This course: 1. Examines the historical context and policies that have contributed to the school-to-prison pipeline.
